declarations.docstring: States that a projective resolution of a module exists.
Shows that a module has a projective resolution with free underlying modules in every degree.
Provides a basis for the underlying module of the associated module object.
Assigns a module object to each module.
The underlying module of the associated module object is free.
The associated module object is projective.
The morphism from the associated module object to the given module.
The morphism from the associated module object to the given module is an epimorphism.
Assigns a projective resolution to a module.
Every degree of this projective resolution has a free underlying module.
Constructs a morphism from the object assigned to a kernel into the source of the original morphism.
Composing the morphism from the assigned kernel object with the original morphism yields zero.
The morphism from the assigned kernel object and the original morphism form an exact short complex.
Constructs a projective resolution from an object assignment with projective values and epimorphisms to the original objects.
Builds a chain complex from an object assignment, morphisms from assigned objects to the original objects, and a chosen object.
The differential from degree one to degree zero is the morphism from the object assigned to the kernel of the comparison map at the chosen object into that map's source.
The constructed complex is exact at every positive successor degree.
In every degree, the constructed projective resolution has a term equal to the object assigned to some object.
Every degree of the constructed complex is projective.
